title: Choose by work structure
when: At intake before creating an item, when the intended execution structure becomes known.
need: Dash executes a stored spec; Issue supports planned single-lane work; Epic requires structural task decomposition; Blitz executes a linked document; Task is laneless and merge-free. Size alone does not choose.
surface: Idea metadata inference; Dash entry; public Workflows and command reference
gap: Public built-in table omits Task and provides no concise intent comparison. Review question: should the first-work guide teach only the matched choice, with the full comparison on request?
